target_product.review_text:
I truly enjoy reading Lisa Renee Jones. You never know which way her stories will go or what will happen. Not everyone is who you think they are and have pasts that will some times make you stop and think. But, most of the times, their pasts is what made them who they are now and the repercussions aren’t as bad as they feel they will be.

This is true for Gabe and Abbie. Gabe feels Abbie will walk away when she finds out about what he has done … Abbie fears that his non-disclosure will do nothing but pull them apart. She comes clean but, it takes a threat for Gabe to finally open up to her. When he does, he’s surprised that she sees another side to everything that he never felt and she’s vowed to make sure he doesn’t feel guilt or shame for anything any more.

This duet was wonderful. It got to the point, brought you deep into the lives of Gabe and Abbie and made you feel a whole bevy of emotions. Gabe may have come off as a hard man but, deep down, he was loving, caring and sweet.

And, LRJ really brought that out. She has a way with words that makes her characters shine, even in their darkest hours.

Review copy provided for a voluntary review.

target_product.review_text: Sav R. Miller is a new to me author, and the premise for Promises and Pomegranates was definitely intriguing because I can't seem to stay away from forced marriage mafia books even if they absolutely set my temper off. Elena is our mafia princess, and as the eldest daughter, it's up to her to be married off to whoever her family picks for her. Dr. Kallum Anderson is known as Dr. Death, and he forces Elena to marry him. This is where it got dicey for me because I wasn't sure why, and I felt like  I didn't get the answers until the very end & those answers didn't have the impact on me they should have. There are twists to this story to allow for f-bomb dropping so I couldn't put it down, and lawd knows that I'm always happy to be kept on my toes in my books. The past of Kallum made for some angst filled moments since he had serious demons tagging along for the ride. I don't know how to explain my feelings without giving spoilers away so I'll just keep this review short & sweet. I'll definitely read this author again, and I hope that y'all will decide for yourselves since this is only my opinion. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

target_product.review_text: Jeremy (Copper) Koynakov is the brother of Jared (Koyn) Koynakov who is the president of the Royal Bastards MC. He's a fed but he's also loyal to his brother so he's walking a fine line between the two. Stormy is a former FBI agent who betrayed the club, so it's up to Copper to make her pay for that betrayal.  He intends to, but somewhere along the line punishment isn't at the forefront of his mind because of the chemistry they have together.  Now, I'm not saying he's let her go, and he has pulled some stuff in the beginning, but you know, the sexy times are too hot to turn his back on.  That's just one part of the book because what's going on with the club is even bigger as the twists are coming in hot from every direction, so the darkness is totally still there as they try to uncover everything.  Copper was a fantastic story that I couldn't get enough of, but when someone was wearing an OU hat, well, it wouldn't have mattered what else happened because that was perfect in my eyes, but it was just the icing on the cake from all this exciting goodness.  Anyway, I certainly can't wait to read Dragon's book after everything that has come out, and HIGHLY HIGHLY HIGHLY RECOMMEND TO ALL!
